_comment: Tier-2: TopologyOptimization requires StructuralMechanicsApplication as a dependency. Pitfall (kratos.topology_optimization #0). NOTE ON THE WRITTEN SIGNAL: this claim carries one of the five shared boilerplate Signal suffixes used across the Kratos catalog, which does not describe what actually happens. The real signal is recorded below and in the fixture output. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). StructuralMechanicsApplication imports; TopologyOptimizationApplication does not (no wheel on PyPI at any version), while the modern replacement OptimizationApplication does. So the dependency is satisfiable but the application named by the claim is not reachable on a pip stack at all. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
